record.purpose: Find the relevant county office and verify incumbent and jurisdiction before any correspondence. This is not a confirmed separate recipient.

sources.source_title: Published county office and professional contact evidence
sources.stated_purpose: Non-sensitive county legal administrative correspondence within documented jurisdiction and office remit.
sources.limitations: Current county department page identifies incumbent; State Bar profile publishes current .gov professional address. County counsel represents the county, not a private complainant. Do not infer independent complaint intake, legal filing or service-of-process authorization. Confirm role, mailbox and remit before use. Deliverability not tested.
